entries.summary: Diagnosed the first scheduled monthly release failure and prepared repository-side recovery changes.

markers.cause: readxl was required by the build scripts but absent from renv.lock

markers.failed_step: Stage and atomically promote in R2
markers.cause: Required GitHub Actions R2 secrets and ATLAS_DATA_BASE_URL were not configured

repository_changes.change: Fail early with the names of missing release configuration
Added incident history, project status, deployment checks, and navigation

external_actions.action: Configure R2_ACCOUNT_ID, R2_BUCKET, R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, and R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY as GitHub Actions secrets
Configure ATLAS_DATA_BASE_URL as a GitHub repository variable
Commit and push the recovery changes
Run monthly-release.yml manually and verify both public latest.json pointers and application loading
Close GitHub issues 1 and 2 after end-to-end verification

repository_checks_completed: All 15 test scripts in the GitHub Actions regression loop passed in the current working tree
